standard_prerequisites: Monoid homomorphisms G -> L (L regarded as a monoid under multiplication) send the neutral element of G to 1
Same chapter use: the Artin-Schreier and power-sum arguments both invoke this lemma (not part of the counted unit)
core_obligations: Base n = 1: chi_1(e) = 1, so lambda_1 chi_1 is identically zero only when lambda_1 = 0
Inductive step: with lambda_n normalized to -1 (divide the relation by -lambda_n), assume for contradiction chi_n(g) = sum lambda_i chi_i(g) for all g

Fix h, use chi_n(hg) = chi_n(h) chi_n(g) and multiplicativity of each chi_i to get 0 = sum lambda_i (chi_n(h) - chi_i(h)) chi_i(g) for all g; the coefficients for the n-1 pairwise distinct characters chi_1, ..., chi_{n-1} cannot all vanish (else chi_n(h) = chi_i(h) for all i and all h, contradicting distinctness), so induction applies and gives the contradiction
proof_roadmap: Derive the combined relation by multiplying with chi_n(h) and subtracting
Close by induction on the n-1 remaining characters and arbitrariness of h
